question: With the rule-built coxa hypothesis channels closing the hair plate -> CNS -> coxa -> hair plate loop, does the coxa move posteriorly where hair plates fire (resistance reflex), opposite under the sign-flipped control, and does H1 fit better than H2?

arms.common: Step C Trial for arm A_ON unchanged (assisted posture, hair plates delivered, same seed/schedule/encoder), 20000 physics steps, 4000 neural ticks, one fresh process per arm, executed once
arms.C0: Step C create_session (live-v3) unchanged; no coxa channels

hypothesis_session.derivation: v3 protocol/records/table derived exactly as live-v3; validate_v3 must pass; then a deep copy marks only the arm's coxa rows neural_motor_admission=True, coordinate_sign=definition sign, motor_status=COXA_HYPOTHESIS_<arm>, handling=baseline_plus_neural_contribution; admitted_motor_interfaces = V3_MOTOR + arm names (sorted by action index)
hypothesis_session.kernel_inputs: motor_channel_names = V3_MOTOR + arm names; supplemental_motor_channels = v3.SUPPLEMENTAL_MOTOR_CHANNELS + arm definitions; all other create_scientific_session arguments identical to tactile_boundary.create_session
hypothesis_session.gate: v3.gate_contributions logic over exactly V3_MOTOR + arm names
hypothesis_session.assertion: v3.assert_v3_physical_admission logic over the derived table: 42-length finite vector, nonzero only on admitted rows, and the admitted set equals V3 + arm rows exactly
hypothesis_session.unchanged: observer 40 ms, activation half 17 Hz, decoder modes, slew 4 rad/s, safe_contribution_bound (0.25 rad for coxa), live_v3_motor_interface module

preflight.P1: D2 result sha256 and status D1_D2_READY match
preflight.P2: kernel resolver accepts v3 supplemental + arm definitions for every H arm; no coxa dense index overlaps a historical (tibia/femur) channel's dense indices
preflight.P3: no coxa readout neuron is in the 444-neuron external schedule (Step C Trial.attach check, enforced at run time)
preflight.P4: local Step C A_ON raw sha256 equals the committed Step C report arm_sha256.A_ON and the protocol value
preflight.P5: derived table differs from the v3 table only in the declared rows/fields; v3 contract valid on the v3 projection

integrity.I1: every arm COMPLETE with 20001 samples and 4000 neural ticks
integrity.I2: per-tick uniforms_sha256 and external schedule identical to C0 in all arms
integrity.I3: C0 equals saved Step C A_ON in fired, uniforms_sha256 and hair_delivered at every tick and qpos at every sample
integrity.I4: v3 channel inventory (names, indices, signs, modes, populations) identical in all arms; H arm channel names equal the D2 definitions; |commanded - baseline| <= 0.25 + 1e-9 rad on every H joint at every sample (baseline = C0 command at that index, which must be constant); every index outside V3 + H equals C0's command at every sample
integrity.I5: each H arm equals C0 in qpos and commanded_joints at every sample before the first sample where an H joint command differs from baseline, and in fired for every tick before that sample's time

measures.firing_legs: legs whose C0 window-mean hair_rate_hz > 0; middle legs reported but excluded if silent
measures.delta_f: per firing leg: window-mean hair_forward (Step B forward component, recorded per tick) in arm minus in C0

Q3.RESISTANCE_CONSISTENT: >= 3 firing legs with H1 posterior shift AND >= 3 of those same legs with H1_FLIP anterior shift
Q3.SIGN_ONLY_CONSISTENT: H1 condition holds, FLIP condition does not

labels.Q4: count of firing legs with posterior shift: H1 > H2 -> H1_FAVOURED; H2 > H1 -> H2_FAVOURED; equal -> NOT_DISTINGUISHED

descriptive: per-leg delta_f time courses (100 ms bins)
coxa MN rates (Step C posterior/anterior sets)
per-H-channel commanded offset mean/max and saturated / slew-limited sample fractions
predictions: Recorded in docs/COXA_HYPOTHESIS_D3_V1.md before running; expectations, not criteria.
interpretation_limits: One seed, assisted posture, offset-on-servo actuation: a shift is a servo setpoint shift, not muscle force or free posture.
Consistency with one published reflex does not validate the binding, admit any coordinate or show balance; motor coverage stays 20/42 proven.
D2 near-ties decide some bindings and are not revisited; H2 tests bodymap labels without rotators.
single_run: Each arm executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed; no retries, no window changes.
